messages:
Ava Chen: Hey team — quick idea: want to do a 20-30min 'micro holiday cheer' hangout Friday 4pm PT? Nothing formal, just show-and-tell of a cozy mug/holiday scarf/playlist + 2-min good news. Poll below for times.
Sam Torres: Love it :tada: I'm in. 4pm PT works for me.
Priya Patel: Count me in. Can we do a short playlist swap too? :notes:
Marco Ruiz: 4pm PT is tight for me, 6pm PT would be better. Also can we keep it to 20 mins? I've got a kid's bedtime.
Ava Chen: Ok how about 20 mins? Poll: `Fri 4pm PT`, `Fri 6pm PT`, `Mon lunch` — vote with emoji.
Sam Torres: :one: for Fri 4pm
Priya Patel: :one:
Marco Ruiz: :two:
DevOps Bot: Reminder: please check calendar availability before voting. :robot_face:
Ava Chen: Noted. If most are :one: we'll do 4pm and I'll post a short Zoom link. If :two: wins, I'll reschedule.
holiday-bot: 🎄 Holiday tip: Attach a screenshot of your cozy setup to the thread so remote folks can join the vibe! :sparkles:
Sam Torres: here's mine — tiny tree + mug (img link): https://imgur.com/example1
Priya Patel: I'm making mulled cider recipe I can share — quick one-liner: `orange + star anise + cinnamon + clove, simmer 20m` :yum:
Marco Ruiz: I can bring a 3-song cozy playlist — dropping in thread soon.
Ava Chen: Cool. Zoom link (temp):
```
https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=xyz
Passcode: cheer
```
Sam Torres: saved! :thumbsup: I'll bring my dad's ugly sweater as a prop.
Priya Patel: Can we do a quick gratitude round? 30s each.
Marco Ruiz: yes please. low-key and warm :heart:
Ava Chen: OK final check — anyone absolutely can't make Fri 4pm PT? Reply 'can't' + reason.
Sam Torres: nope, I'm good.
Priya Patel: can't — travel day. if 6pm wins I can make it.
Marco Ruiz: I can make 4pm.
Ava Chen: Thanks! I'll tally and post the final invite. Also we'll do the playlist + 2 mins of show-and-tell. :confetti_ball:
